digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow gates and model resolution
propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries hardcode bare Anthropic model names, causing resolved steps to bypass configured provider and resolve to direct Anthropic even when configured for another provider (split-brain at entry rung)

Escalation via models_at_or_above returns bare Anthropic names for ladder rungs, causing a Bedrock-primary run to silently escalate to direct Anthropic on context exhaustion (split-brain at escalation)
Three separate code paths (production_batch_runner, code_review batch_runner, DefaultBatchRunner) all have identical model_ladder[0] resolution patterns that must be unified
MODEL_LADDER serves dual roles (escalation order and P8 context-window budget via substring matching) that would break silently if ladder entries become class names instead of bare model names

Class names (trivial, standard, frontier) reserved in the model-string space must resolve through load_class_slots at call sites, with lazy import of model_classes into config.py to avoid an import cycle
